lines: Dr. Dharminder Kumar Nagar, role unknown, is set to receive money from selling 4,329,004 shares in the offer for sale.
Up to ₹300.00 crore in proceeds, with listing scheduled for On or about Wednesday, October 28, 2026 per the offer document's timetable.
Gain of ₹298.98 crore before offer expenses and taxes; retained stake of about ₹4,794.88 crore (estimate, valued at offer price) could mean more value later.
Role is unknown and the listing date is not yet confirmed by a listing notice.
